component.name: LinStress
component.summary: CPU, RAM and GPU stress tests with frequency tuning

description.p: LinStress checks that your computer stays stable under load. It shows live temperatures and frequencies, and stops every test automatically when a temperature limit is reached.

ul.li: CPU stress test with a choice of thread count
RAM test that writes patterns and counts memory errors
GPU stress test through Vulkan (NVIDIA, AMD and Intel)
CPU frequency limit and governor control
